findings.explanation: Stock watch builds and Android installs share MOTONAV1, and the watch has no pinned address by default. If two stock Moto Nav phones are nearby, the watch can accept the first phone's idle frame, stay connected to it, and later show and vibrate for that phone's turns. Require a matching per-installation token or a configured peer address before enabling live guidance.

Only watchdog expiry puts a failed address on the skip list. An earlier advertiser that immediately rejects connect, disconnects after state 1, or fails service or subscription setup can be chosen on every retry while the intended phone appears in the same scan batch. A Node probe reproduced repeated selection after connect failure. Record all pre-frame connection failures in the shared retry path and prefer untried candidates throughout the batch.

A single transient start failure can exclude the working V3 scan variant for the rest of the watch session. The failure table resets only if every variant fails to start. If another variant starts successfully but finds no matching phone, the no-match rotation keeps skipping V3. A Node probe reproduced the cycle. Make failed variants eligible again after a complete sweep.

A scheduled retry can reopen GATT after the rider stops the foreground service. The delayed callback checks `created`, which remains true after `onDestroy`, and teardown removes only the heartbeat runnable. The same retry can run while Bluetooth is off or after `STATE_ON` has already started a replacement server. Clear the active flag before teardown, cancel the single pending retry on stop and Bluetooth transitions, and resume retries on `STATE_ON`.

The scan deadline is discarded after any UUID match, even when address selection rejects that result. A different Moto Nav phone can suppress the only deadline while the configured phone is absent. A one-off result from a skipped peer has the same effect. A Node probe reproduced a live scan with no attempt deadline and no retry. Keep the deadline until an eligible peer is selected.

V0 and V2 accept results with no advertising bytes on the strength of the system filter, which the controller observed failing to filter on this S5. The byte matcher also accepts the UUID inside manufacturer data. A Node probe confirmed both acceptance paths. Require the UUID in a correctly formed 128-bit service UUID advertising field, and reject data-free results on the S5.

Scan callbacks remain valid after the scanner is released for GATT connection because both phases share the same generation. In a Node probe, delivering a queued scan failure after selecting the target aborted the valid connection attempt. Scope failure callbacks and the scan watchdog to the active scanner and invalidate that scope before releasing it.

Advertising callbacks check only the GATT generation, but advertising can restart within that generation. If a previous start callback arrives after `restartAdvertising`, its failure can close the replacement GATT session or its success can mark the replacement as advertising before it starts. Track a pending advertising start and accept callbacks only from the current `advCallback`.

The page can cut off its one loss vibration. After the render timer detects stale data and starts the pulse, a disconnect cancels it even though `invalidate` returns no replacement. A subsequent stale heartbeat also requests cancellation, as reproduced in a Node probe. Once loss is signaled, cancel only any turn pattern and let the loss pulse finish unless guidance recovers or the page stops.

If an urgent warning arrives before the previous start callback supplies its task ID, `play` submits the urgent task before it can stop the old one. Vela documents error 205 when a task already exists. That path can reduce the three-pulse warning to one uncancellable pulse. Retain the latest requested pattern until the pending start resolves, stop the old task, then start the replacement. [Vela vibrator API](https://iot.mi.com/vela/quickapp/zh/features/system/vibrator.html)

When the instruction before the street is unknown, the parser rescans the entire text for a maneuver. For `100 m` and `Merge onto Left Fork Road`, it derives a left turn from the road name and can vibrate for it. The greedy split can also pull street-name words into the maneuver, as in `Turn left onto Right Fork Road on the Hill`. Isolate the destination at the maneuver's separator and limit the fallback to explicit constructions such as `Vào vòng xuyến`.

The earlier signed-distance fix guards only up to three spaces after a sign. A malformed `-    30 m` is still matched as `30 m`, which can trigger the urgent warning. A regex probe confirmed the match. Validate the full numeric token, including its sign and intervening whitespace, before converting it.

`sendResponse` can return false without throwing. The CCCD write path still counts the peer as subscribed and pumps a snapshot after that failure. Check the return value and roll back the subscription change when a required response cannot be queued. [Android GATT server API](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/bluetooth/BluetoothGattServer#sendResponse(android.bluetooth.BluetoothDevice,int,int,int,byte%5B%5D))

The deduplication hash includes `postTime`. Reposts with identical notification content and icons can each consume a capture slot solely because their timestamps differ. Once the cap is reached, later distinct maneuvers are discarded. Keep `postTime` in the saved JSON and exclude it from the deduplication input.

The local-demo hint occupies y=228–264 while the distance occupies y=160–252 and the street starts at y=254. All three can be shown together, so the hint can overlap the navigation text. Place the demo label in a dedicated status row.

limits: Reviewed the current in-scope files, protocol and named round-07 findings. The checkout contains no Git metadata or supplied baseline diff, so exact change attribution and the distinction between tracked and untracked files could not be verified.

Ran focused read-only Node probes for scan selection, retry rotation, callback ordering, advertisement matching, loss state and parser regexes. Kotlin and page integration findings are based on source inspection. The full test, lint and build results were supplied by the controller.
The controller supplied the single-phone S5 bring-up evidence. Real Maps notifications, wrist-down behavior, OPPO Bluetooth-toggle recovery and two-peripheral behavior remain unverified on hardware.
